== Description ==
The '''Truck2''' was the original third vehicle spawned from the [[Military Base]], when it was at Level 2. As with other [[units]], it started from the end of the map path and moved towards the entrance of the map. A '''Truck2''' spawned at the start of every wave, one for every Level 2 [[Military Base]], then every 65 seconds after if the wave did not end.

The '''Truck2''' was replaced by the [[Humvee 2]] after the [[Release v1.0|MEGA Update]].

==Appearance==
The '''Truck2''' was similar to the [[Truck1]], as both were green trucks with an open bed. The main difference was that the '''Truck2''' had a spiked bumper and a thicker running board. '''Truck2''' had six metallic wheels and two headlamps.

== Strategy ==
*Singular '''Truck2s''' can fare well against [[Normal]]s, [[Speedy|Speedies]], [[Mystery|Mysteries]] and [[Hidden]]s. Multiple '''Truck2s''' fare well against [[Necromancer (Legacy Enemy)|Necromancer]]s and [[Normal Boss]]es.
**Be aware that you do not get any money from the '''Truck2''' colliding with enemies.
*On two-pathed maps, only one '''Truck2''' will spawn per Level 2 [[Military Base]]. It will go down a specific path on these maps.
*The [[Brute]], [[Tank|Tank 1]] and [[Tank 2]] can destroy the '''Truck2''' if a rock lands on it.

== Trivia ==
*The '''Truck2''' was originally known as the '''Humvee2''', even though the appearance of the vehicle looked nothing like a [[wp:Humvee|Humvee]].
*The [[Humvee 2]] replaced '''Truck2''' in the MEGA Update.
*The '''Truck2''' returned as a skin for the {{Color|Premium|Classic}} [[Humvee 2]], though it uses a different model.
*The '''Truck2''' was based on the [[wp:M939 Truck|M939 Truck]].
